Buster Bros..summary: The Game Boy version of Buster Bros. (also known as Pang in some regions) is a portable adaptation of the arcade game developed by Mitchell Corporation. Released in 1990, it retains the core gameplay, where players use a harpoon gun to pop bouncing bubbles while avoiding contact. The game features multiple levels set in different world locations, but with simplified graphics and gameplay adjustments for the handheld system.
